checklist.title: Feature Flag & Zero-Regression Guard
checklist.description: BIBLEFLOW_ENABLED env var gates all BibleFlow code paths. When false, FreeShow behaves identically to the upstream fork.
criteria: Setting BIBLEFLOW=false at build time produces a bundle with no BibleFlow imports reachable at runtime
All 37 original FreeShow tests pass with BIBLEFLOW=false
No console errors or warnings when BibleFlow is disabled
BIBLEFLOW IPC channel is never registered when flag is false

checklist.title: External Display Integration (Option A)
checklist.description: BibleFlow reuses FreeShow's OutputSend.sendToOutputWindow() via a new BIBLEFLOW IPC channel. No competing BrowserWindows are created.
criteria: BIBLEFLOW channel registered in src/types/Channels.ts and ValidChannels union
ipcMain.on(BIBLEFLOW) handler fans out messages to all output windows via OutputHelper.Send.sendToOutputWindow
BibleFlowOverlay.svelte mounts inside the existing output window (not a new window)
Overlay unmounts cleanly on destroy without leaking IPC listeners
9 smoke tests pass in bibleflow-display.test.ts

checklist.title: Broadcast Controller
checklist.description: State machine managing auto/manual broadcast modes, verse queue, cooldown, and confidence threshold.
criteria: Starts in manual mode by default
Enqueues verses and deduplicates by reference+translation
Manual mode: approve(id) sends exactly that verse and removes it from queue
Auto mode: sends highest-confidence verse after cooldownMs elapses
Auto mode: respects confidenceThreshold — skips below-threshold verses
Auto mode: cooldown prevents re-send before interval elapses
clearDisplay() sends null and sets active to null
DEFAULT_STATE.queue is never mutated across controller instances
9 tests pass in BroadcastController.test.ts

checklist.title: Transcription Adapters
checklist.description: Pluggable transcription backend — Deepgram (WebSocket PCM) and Whisper (local HTTP). TranscriptionManager builds and switches providers.
criteria: TranscriptionAdapter interface defines name, start(deviceId, onSegment), stop(), isRunning()
DeepgramAdapter streams 16kHz Int16Array PCM over WebSocket; API key never hardcoded
WhisperAdapter posts 5-second MediaRecorder chunks to localhost:8080/inference
TranscriptionManager.build('deepgram'|'whisper') returns correct adapter
Switching provider calls stop() on previous and start() on new adapter
4 tests pass in TranscriptionManager.test.ts

checklist.title: Bible Reference Parser & Verse Detector
checklist.description: Regex-based parser covering all 66 canonical books with aliases. Detects references in free text and maps to DetectedVerse objects.
criteria: All 66 canonical book names recognized
Common abbreviations and aliases recognized (e.g. 'Ps', 'Rev', '1 Cor')
Verse range notation parsed (e.g. 'John 3:16-17')
parseReferences returns empty array for text with no references
formatReference produces canonical string (e.g. 'John 3:16')
VerseDetector maps parsed refs to DetectedVerse with configurable translation
9 tests pass in BibleReferenceParser.test.ts

checklist.title: Theme Designer
checklist.description: Typed BibleFlowThemeV1 schema with versioned JSON import/export. Merges with defaults on import.
criteria: BibleFlowThemeV1 has version:1 discriminator field
exportTheme() produces valid JSON string
importTheme() parses and merges with DEFAULT_THEME
importTheme() throws on wrong version
importTheme() throws on non-JSON input
5 tests pass in ThemeSchema.test.ts

checklist.title: Multi-Output Router
checklist.description: Routes verse display to main output, alternate output, or both independently.
criteria: OutputTarget type is 'main'|'alternate'|'both'
MultiOutputRouter sends to correct target(s) based on config
Routing does not affect FreeShow's own output logic

checklist.title: Remote Control (HTTP + OSC)
checklist.description: Local HTTP REST API on 127.0.0.1:47921 with Bearer token auth. OSC/UDP on port 57121.
criteria: HTTP server binds only to 127.0.0.1 (never 0.0.0.0)
GET /status returns 200 with current state
POST /send dispatches verse
POST /clear clears display
POST /queue/approve approves queued verse by id
Requests without valid Bearer token return 401
OSC /bibleflow/send, /bibleflow/clear, /bibleflow/approve handled
5 tests pass in HttpApiServer.test.ts

checklist.title: Bible Store (Translations)
checklist.description: Public-domain KJV and ASV bundled. Licensed translations (NIV/ESV/NLT) gated behind LicenseManager. Lookup via bible-api.com.
criteria: KJV and ASV available without license
NIV/ESV/NLT return error when not licensed
NIV/ESV/NLT accessible when licensed
lookup() calls bible-api.com with correct parameters
5 tests pass in BibleStore.test.ts

checklist.title: Audio Input Manager
checklist.description: Device selection, gain control (±40 dB clamped), and Web Audio API integration.
criteria: setDevice(id) changes active input device
setGain(dB) clamps to ±40 dB
attachGainNode() wires node into AudioContext graph
listDevices() returns available audio input devices
5 tests pass in AudioInputManager.test.ts

checklist.title: Sermon Notes Manager
checklist.description: Accumulates transcript, deduplicates references, generates AI outline via injected function, exports Markdown and plain text.
criteria: appendTranscript() accumulates text
addReference() deduplicates by canonical reference string
generateOutline() calls injected AI function and returns result
exportMarkdown() includes header, references section, and transcript
exportPlainText() produces plain string without Markdown syntax
5 tests pass in SermonNotesManager.test.ts

checklist.title: i18n Strings
checklist.description: 24-key BibleFlowStrings type, EN built-in, setLocale/registerLocale/t API, falls back to EN for missing keys.
criteria: All 24 BibleFlowStrings keys defined in EN locale
setLocale('en') and t(key) return correct strings
Unknown locale falls back to EN
registerLocale() allows custom locales
Untranslated keys in custom locale fall through to EN
4 tests pass in strings.test.ts

checklist.title: License Manager
checklist.description: Key format validation, online activation, offline fallback, revocation, and list. Format: BFXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
criteria: Malformed key rejected without calling online validator
Valid key + online=true activates license and marks offlineValid
Valid key + online=false (validator rejects) returns error
Offline use allowed if key was previously validated online
revoke() removes license
listLicenses() returns all active licenses
6 tests pass in LicenseManager.test.ts
